blocks.text: A private capital-markets and order-management platform serving web and mobile clients (Vue 3, Quasar, Capacitor) behind a Spring Cloud Gateway. Core trading, account, market data, and exchange workflows are separated into Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.3 microservices backed by PostgreSQL, Redis, and RabbitMQ. Specific client branding, hostnames, and operational metrics are omitted under NDA.

blocks.text: Joined the existing multi-repo platform on November 4 as a full-stack Software Engineer at Proficient Information Systems (sister concern of IT Conquest). Working within a senior-led full-stack team (architecture led by Sazal and Shamim), I contribute targeted frontend and backend slices while participating in architecture discussions, proposals, and peer code reviews.

items.text: **Active Window:** November 12–16, 2026 (following onboarding and environment ramp from November 4).
**Frontend (`Vue 3 / Quasar`):** 24 commits across `workspace`, `auth`, `notifications`, and `boAccount` modules — improving client scoping, i18n, notification UX, and back-office fee UI.
**Backend (`Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.3`):** 6 commits in `oms-service` implementing matching back-office (BO) fee configuration endpoints.
**Visuals:** No screenshots included per client confidentiality.

blocks.text: Within the senior-led microservice workflow, my early delivery focused on three NDA-safe product and integration slices:

items.text: **Client Scoping & i18n (`workspace` / `auth`):** Standardized client-context scoping across workspace views and resolved localization gaps across shared UI copy and form labels.
**Notification UX (`notifications`):** Refined real-time alert presentation, read/unread state handling, and layout consistency across desktop and responsive viewports.
**Back-Office Fee Configuration (`boAccount` ↔ `oms-service`):** Delivered the end-to-end BO fee configuration UI in Vue 3 / Quasar paired with matching Spring Boot OMS API endpoints.
